test_cases.description: When carry_patch.enabled is True and a HubClient is provided, the fix pipeline calls push_to_remote(), add_patch(), submit_rebuild(), and poll_rebuild() in order after the coder-reviewer loop completes.
preconditions: A mock HubClient is injected into the fix pipeline
hub_client.add_patch() is mocked to return success
hub_client.submit_rebuild() is mocked to return a RebuildJob(id='job-1', status='queued')
poll_rebuild() is mocked to return RebuildJob(id='job-1', status='completed')
The coder-reviewer loop has completed successfully

input.issue_title: Fix null pointer in auth module

add_patch_called_with.description: Fix null pointer in auth module

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: issue = Issue(title='Fix null pointer in auth module'); mock_push = mock(push_to_remote); mock_add = mock(hub_client.add_patch); mock_submit = mock(hub_client.submit_rebuild, returns=RebuildJob(id='job-1', status='queued')); mock_poll = mock(poll_rebuild, returns=RebuildJob(id='job-1', status='completed')); run_fix_pipeline_integration_phase(config, hub_client, slug='my-workspace', branch_name='fix/issue-42', issue=issue); assert mock_push.called_once(); assert mock_add.called_once_with(slug='my-workspace', branch_name='fix/issue-42', description='Fix null pointer in auth module', skip_branch_check=True, if_not_exists=True); assert mock_submit.called_once_with(slug='my-workspace'); assert mock_poll.called_once_with(hub_client, 'my-workspace', rebuild_id='job-1', timeout=ANY, interval=ANY); assert call_order == ['push_to_remote', 'add_patch', 'submit_rebuild', 'poll_rebuild']

test_cases.description: When poll_rebuild() returns a RebuildJob with status 'completed' (not submit_rebuild(), which only returns 'queued'), the fix pipeline proceeds with normal issue closure.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mock_close_issue = mock(close_issue_fn); result = await run_fix_pipeline_integration_phase(config, hub_client, slug='my-workspace', branch_name='fix/issue-42'); assert mock_close_issue.called_once(); assert issue_retry_state_set == False; assert result is None or result indicates success

test_cases.description: When poll_rebuild() resolves to a RebuildJob with status 'failed' or 'dead_letter', the fix pipeline logs the failure and marks the issue for retry.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mock_poll = mock(poll_rebuild, returns=RebuildJob(id='job-1', status='failed')); mock_retry = mock(mark_issue_for_retry); await run_fix_pipeline_integration_phase(config, hub_client, slug='my-workspace', branch_name='fix/issue-42'); assert mock_retry.called_once(); assert logger.has_error_or_warning_containing('failed'); assert no_exception_raised

test_cases.description: When submit_rebuild() raises HubConflictError, the fix pipeline calls list_rebuilds() to get the active job and polls that job instead.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mock_submit = mock(hub_client.submit_rebuild, raises=HubConflictError()); mock_list = mock(hub_client.list_rebuilds, returns=[RebuildJob(id='active-job-1', status='running')]); mock_poll = mock(poll_rebuild, returns=RebuildJob(id='active-job-1', status='completed')); await run_fix_pipeline_integration_phase(config, hub_client, slug='my-workspace', branch_name='fix/issue-42'); assert mock_list.called_once_with(slug='my-workspace'); assert mock_poll.called_once_with(hub_client, 'my-workspace', rebuild_id='active-job-1', timeout=ANY, interval=ANY)

test_cases.description: When submit_rebuild() raises HubNoActivePatchesError, the fix pipeline logs a warning and skips the rebuild step without marking the issue for retry.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mock_submit = mock(hub_client.submit_rebuild, raises=HubNoActivePatchesError()); mock_poll = mock(poll_rebuild); mock_retry = mock(mark_issue_for_retry); await run_fix_pipeline_integration_phase(config, hub_client, slug='my-workspace', branch_name='fix/issue-42'); assert mock_poll.not_called(); assert mock_retry.not_called(); assert logger.has_warning_containing('no active patches')

test_cases.description: When patch registration and rebuild polling complete successfully, the fix pipeline emits CARRY_PATCH_PATCH_REGISTERED, CARRY_PATCH_REBUILD_REQUESTED, and CARRY_PATCH_REBUILD_COMPLETED audit events.
preconditions: emit_audit_event() is mocked to capture calls
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mock_emit = mock(emit_audit_event); await run_fix_pipeline_integration_phase(config, hub_client, slug='my-workspace', branch_name='fix/issue-42'); emitted_types = [call.args[2] for call in mock_emit.calls]; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_PATCH_REGISTERED in emitted_types; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_REBUILD_REQUESTED in emitted_types; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_REBUILD_COMPLETED in emitted_types

test_cases.description: CarryPatchMonitor exposes the correct constructor signature and an async run_cycle() method returning MonitorCycleResult.
preconditions: A mock HubClient, AgentFoxConfig, and NightShiftEngine are available
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: import CarryPatchMonitor, MonitorCycleResult from afcore.nightshift.carry_patch_monitor; monitor = CarryPatchMonitor(hub_client=mock_hub_client, workspace_slug='test-workspace', config=mock_config, engine=mock_engine); assert isinstance(monitor, CarryPatchMonitor); assert asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(monitor.run_cycle); result = await monitor.run_cycle(); assert isinstance(result, MonitorCycleResult)

test_cases.description: MonitorCycleResult is a dataclass with the five required fields of the correct types.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: import dataclasses; from afcore.nightshift.carry_patch_monitor import MonitorCycleResult; assert dataclasses.is_dataclass(MonitorCycleResult); r = MonitorCycleResult(conflicts_detected=3, conflicts_resolved=2, conflicts_failed=1, patches_merged=0, rebuild_triggered=True); assert r.conflicts_detected == 3; assert r.conflicts_resolved == 2; assert r.conflicts_failed == 1; assert r.patches_merged == 0; assert r.rebuild_triggered == True

test_cases.description: run_cycle() calls hub_client.get_patch_status(slug), logs merged_upstream patches, and returns a MonitorCycleResult reflecting the cycle outcome.
preconditions: hub_client.get_patch_status('ws-1') returns PatchStatusDashboard with one merged_upstream patch and one conflict patch
Coder session and rebuild are mocked to succeed
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mock_get_status = mock(hub_client.get_patch_status, returns=PatchStatusDashboard(patches=[PatchDetail(status='merged_upstream', id='p1'), PatchDetail(status='conflict', id='p2', conflict_files=[])])); result = await monitor.run_cycle(); assert mock_get_status.called_once_with('ws-1'); assert logger.has_info_containing('merged_upstream'); assert isinstance(result, MonitorCycleResult); assert result.patches_merged == 1

test_cases.description: run_cycle() emits CARRY_PATCH_CONFLICT_DETECTED for each patch with status 'conflict' before the retry counter check, with patch_id in the payload.
preconditions: CarryPatchMonitor is instantiated with workspace_slug='ws-1', sink=mock_sink, run_id='run-123'
hub_client.get_patch_status returns PatchStatusDashboard with two conflict patches: id='p1' and id='p2'
emit_audit_event() is mocked to capture calls
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mock_emit = mock(emit_audit_event); await monitor.run_cycle(); detected_calls = [c for c in mock_emit.calls if c.args[2] == AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_CONFLICT_DETECTED]; assert len(detected_calls) == 2; patch_ids = [c.kwargs.get('payload', {}).get('patch_id') for c in detected_calls]; assert 'p1' in patch_ids; assert 'p2' in patch_ids

test_cases.description: When auto_resolve is False, run_cycle() logs the conflict count and returns a MonitorCycleResult with conflicts_detected set and all resolution counts at zero.
preconditions: hub_client.get_patch_status('ws-1') returns PatchStatusDashboard with 2 conflict patches
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mock_coder = mock(engine._run_coder_session); result = await monitor.run_cycle(); assert result.conflicts_detected == 2; assert result.conflicts_resolved == 0; assert result.conflicts_failed == 0; assert result.rebuild_triggered == False; assert mock_coder.not_called(); assert logger.has_info_containing('2')

test_cases.description: When auto_resolve is True and a patch is under max_resolve_retries, run_cycle() checks out the branch, invokes the coder session in carry-patch mode, pushes, submits rebuild, and polls.
preconditions: Session retry counter for patch 'p1' is 0
hub_client.get_patch_status returns one conflict patch with id='p1'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mock_fetch = mock(fetch_remote); mock_checkout = mock(checkout_branch); mock_coder = mock(engine._run_coder_session, returns=success); mock_push = mock(push_to_remote); mock_submit = mock(hub_client.submit_rebuild, returns=RebuildJob(id='job-1', status='queued')); mock_poll = mock(poll_rebuild, returns=RebuildJob(id='job-1', status='completed')); result = await monitor.run_cycle(); assert mock_fetch.called(); assert mock_checkout.called(); assert mock_coder.called_with(archetype='coder', mode='carry-patch'); assert mock_push.called(); assert mock_submit.called(); assert mock_poll.called(); assert result.conflicts_resolved == 1; assert result.rebuild_triggered == True

test_cases.description: When a patch's session retry counter has reached max_resolve_retries, run_cycle() skips it, logs a warning with patch ID and branch name, and increments conflicts_failed.
preconditions: Session retry counter for patch 'p1' is already 3
hub_client.get_patch_status returns one conflict patch with id='p1', branch='fix/p1'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: monitor._retry_counter[('ws-1', 'p1')] = 3; mock_coder = mock(engine._run_coder_session); result = await monitor.run_cycle(); assert mock_coder.not_called(); assert logger.has_warning_containing('p1'); assert logger.has_warning_containing('fix/p1'); assert result.conflicts_failed == 1; assert result.conflicts_resolved == 0

test_cases.description: When a conflict resolution attempt succeeds, run_cycle() emits CARRY_PATCH_CONFLICT_RESOLVED via emit_audit_event().
preconditions: emit_audit_event() is mocked to capture calls
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mock_emit = mock(emit_audit_event); await monitor.run_cycle(); emitted_types = [call.args[2] for call in mock_emit.calls]; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_CONFLICT_RESOLVED in emitted_types

test_cases.description: When a conflict resolution attempt fails, run_cycle() increments the session retry counter and emits CARRY_PATCH_CONFLICT_FAILED.
preconditions: engine._run_coder_session() raises an exception simulating failure
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mock_coder = mock(engine._run_coder_session, raises=RuntimeError('coder failed')); mock_emit = mock(emit_audit_event); await monitor.run_cycle(); assert monitor._retry_counter[('ws-1', 'p1')] == 1; emitted_types = [call.args[2] for call in mock_emit.calls]; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_CONFLICT_FAILED in emitted_types

test_cases.description: Before invoking the coder session, run_cycle() assembles a context dict with patch_description (from patch_detail.description), conflict_files, upstream_context from git diff, and rerere_resolutions as path strings extracted from RerereEntry objects returned by list_rerere().
preconditions: PatchDetail has description='Fix auth bug', conflict_files=['auth.py']
engine._run_coder_session() is mocked to capture context argument
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: from afhub import RerereEntry; mock_rerere = mock(hub_client.list_rerere, returns=[RerereEntry(path='auth.py', recorded_at='2026-01-01')]); mock_coder = mock(engine._run_coder_session); await monitor.run_cycle(); ctx = mock_coder.call_args['context']; assert ctx['patch_description'] == 'Fix auth bug'; assert ctx['conflict_files'] == ['auth.py']; assert 'diff' in ctx['upstream_context']; assert ctx['rerere_resolutions'] == ['auth.py']  # path strings, not RerereEntry objects

test_cases.description: run_cycle() only calls list_rerere() (a read operation) and never calls any write or mutation rerere API method.
preconditions: hub_client has both list_rerere() and hypothetical write_rerere() methods mocked
One conflict patch exists in the dashboard
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mock_list_rerere = mock(hub_client.list_rerere, returns=[]); mock_write_rerere = mock(hub_client, 'write_rerere'); await monitor.run_cycle(); assert mock_list_rerere.called(); assert mock_write_rerere.not_called(); assert no_other_rerere_mutation_calls_on(hub_client)

test_cases.description: The coder archetype registry in archetypes.py contains a 'carry-patch' key with ModeConfig(model_tier='STANDARD', max_turns=200, thinking_mode='adaptive', effort='high').
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: from afcore.archetypes import get_archetype_mode; mode_cfg = get_archetype_mode('coder', 'carry-patch'); assert mode_cfg.model_tier == 'STANDARD'; assert mode_cfg.max_turns == 200; assert mode_cfg.thinking_mode == 'adaptive'; assert mode_cfg.effort == 'high'

test_cases.description: The file afcore/_templates/profiles/coder_carry-patch.md exists and contains instructions for preserving patch intent, adapting only conflict files, using conventional commits, running tests, and explaining the resolution.
preconditions: afcore package is installed or source is available at the expected path
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: import pathlib; path = pathlib.Path('packages/afcore/afcore/_templates/profiles/coder_carry-patch.md'); assert path.exists(); content = path.read_text(); assert 'patch' in content.lower() and 'intent' in content.lower(); assert 'conflict' in content.lower(); assert 'fix: resolve conflict' in content; assert 'test' in content.lower(); assert 'commit message' in content.lower() or 'body' in content.lower()

test_cases.description: build_streams() includes a CarryPatchStream with name='carry-patch', check_interval from config, and enabled=True when carry_patch.enabled is True and HubClient is available.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: from afcore.nightshift.streams import build_streams; streams = build_streams(config=config, hub_client=mock_hub_client); carry_patch_streams = [s for s in streams if s.name == 'carry-patch']; assert len(carry_patch_streams) == 1; s = carry_patch_streams[0]; assert s.check_interval == 60; assert s.enabled == True

test_cases.description: build_streams() omits CarryPatchStream when carry_patch.enabled is False or HubClient is None.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: from afcore.nightshift.streams import build_streams; streams_disabled = build_streams(config=config_disabled, hub_client=mock_hub_client); assert not any(s.name == 'carry-patch' for s in streams_disabled); streams_no_hub = build_streams(config=config_enabled, hub_client=None); assert not any(s.name == 'carry-patch' for s in streams_no_hub)

test_cases.description: daemon.py contains 'carry-patch' as a key in both _STREAM_DISPLAY_NAMES and _STREAM_ACTIVE_LABELS with non-empty human-readable values.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: from afcore.nightshift.daemon import _STREAM_DISPLAY_NAMES, _STREAM_ACTIVE_LABELS; assert 'carry-patch' in _STREAM_DISPLAY_NAMES; assert len(_STREAM_DISPLAY_NAMES['carry-patch']) > 0; assert 'carry-patch' in _STREAM_ACTIVE_LABELS; assert len(_STREAM_ACTIVE_LABELS['carry-patch']) > 0

test_cases.description: _run_carry_patch_monitor(slug) on NightShiftEngine delegates to CarryPatchMonitor.run_cycle() and returns a MonitorCycleResult.
preconditions: NightShiftEngine is instantiated with carry_patch config and a mock HubClient
CarryPatchMonitor.run_cycle() is mocked to return MonitorCycleResult(conflicts_detected=1, conflicts_resolved=1, conflicts_failed=0, patches_merged=0, rebuild_triggered=True)
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mock_run_cycle = mock(CarryPatchMonitor.run_cycle, returns=MonitorCycleResult(conflicts_detected=1, conflicts_resolved=1, conflicts_failed=0, patches_merged=0, rebuild_triggered=True)); result = await engine._run_carry_patch_monitor(slug='ws-1'); assert isinstance(result, MonitorCycleResult); assert result.conflicts_detected == 1; assert result.conflicts_resolved == 1

test_cases.description: All eight carry-patch audit event type constants are importable from afaudit.events with the correct string values.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: from afaudit.events import AuditEventType; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_CONFLICT_DETECTED == 'carry_patch.conflict_detected'; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_CONFLICT_RESOLVED == 'carry_patch.conflict_resolved'; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_CONFLICT_FAILED == 'carry_patch.conflict_failed'; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_PATCH_REGISTERED == 'carry_patch.patch_registered'; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_REBUILD_REQUESTED == 'carry_patch.rebuild_requested'; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_REBUILD_COMPLETED == 'carry_patch.rebuild_completed'; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_REBUILD_FAILED == 'carry_patch.rebuild_failed'; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_MERGED_DETECTED == 'carry_patch.merged_detected'

test_cases.description: emit_audit_event() is called with the correct AuditEventType constant at each significant carry-patch state transition in both the fix pipeline and CarryPatchMonitor.
preconditions: emit_audit_event() is mocked to capture all calls
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mock_emit = mock(emit_audit_event); await run_fix_pipeline_integration_phase(config, hub_client, slug='ws-1', branch_name='fix/issue-1'); await monitor.run_cycle(); all_emitted = [call.args[2] for call in mock_emit.calls]; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_PATCH_REGISTERED in all_emitted; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_REBUILD_REQUESTED in all_emitted; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_REBUILD_COMPLETED in all_emitted; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_CONFLICT_DETECTED in all_emitted; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_CONFLICT_RESOLVED in all_emitted

property_tests.description: For any fix pipeline execution with carry_patch.enabled=True and a HubClient, the local harvest path is never executed and add_patch() is always called before submit_rebuild().
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random combinations of: valid slug strings, branch name strings, and mock HubClient responses (success, various errors). Always set config.carry_patch.enabled=True and provide a non-None HubClient.
property_tests.invariant_check: mock_harvest = mock(local_harvest_fn); mock_add = mock(hub_client.add_patch); mock_submit = mock(hub_client.submit_rebuild); await run_fix_pipeline_integration_phase(config, hub_client, slug=slug, branch_name=branch); assert mock_harvest.not_called(); if mock_add.called() and mock_submit.called(): assert mock_add.call_order < mock_submit.call_order

property_tests.description: For any run_cycle() invocation, conflicts_resolved + conflicts_failed <= conflicts_detected and all count fields are non-negative integers.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate PatchStatusDashboard instances with 0 to 20 patches in random combinations of statuses ('conflict', 'merged_upstream', 'pending', 'applied'). Randomly configure auto_resolve (True/False) and max_resolve_retries (1-5). Randomly make coder sessions succeed or fail.
property_tests.invariant_check: result = await monitor.run_cycle(); assert isinstance(result.conflicts_detected, int) and result.conflicts_detected >= 0; assert isinstance(result.conflicts_resolved, int) and result.conflicts_resolved >= 0; assert isinstance(result.conflicts_failed, int) and result.conflicts_failed >= 0; assert isinstance(result.patches_merged, int) and result.patches_merged >= 0; assert result.conflicts_resolved + result.conflicts_failed <= result.conflicts_detected

property_tests.description: For any patch that has been attempted max_resolve_retries times, no further coder sessions are started for that patch in the same session, and conflicts_failed is incremented instead.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate a patch ID and set its retry counter to max_resolve_retries (sampled from 1 to 10). Generate a PatchStatusDashboard with that patch in conflict status. Run run_cycle() multiple times (2 to 5 times) in the same monitor session.
property_tests.invariant_check: mock_coder = mock(engine._run_coder_session); for _ in range(num_cycles): await monitor.run_cycle(); coder_calls_for_patch = [c for c in mock_coder.calls if c.args_match(patch_id)]; assert len(coder_calls_for_patch) == 0; assert monitor._retry_counter[('ws-1', patch_id)] == max_resolve_retries

property_tests.description: For any run_cycle() invocation where get_patch_status() raises any exception, run_cycle() returns a MonitorCycleResult with all counts at zero and does not propagate the exception.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample from a variety of exception types: ConnectionError, TimeoutError, ValueError, RuntimeError, KeyError, OSError. For each, mock hub_client.get_patch_status() to raise that exception.
property_tests.invariant_check: for exc_type in [ConnectionError, TimeoutError, ValueError, RuntimeError, KeyError, OSError]: mock_get_status = mock(hub_client.get_patch_status, raises=exc_type()); result = await monitor.run_cycle(); assert result.conflicts_detected == 0; assert result.conflicts_resolved == 0; assert result.conflicts_failed == 0; assert result.patches_merged == 0; assert result.rebuild_triggered == False

property_tests.description: For any carry-patch operation that reaches a state transition, exactly one emit_audit_event() call is made with the corresponding AuditEventType constant, and audit emission failures do not abort the operation.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Run the fix pipeline and monitor cycle with all steps succeeding. Then repeat with emit_audit_event() mocked to raise RuntimeError. Sample multiple slug/branch combinations.
property_tests.invariant_check: mock_emit = mock(emit_audit_event); await run_fix_pipeline_integration_phase(config, hub_client, slug=slug, branch_name=branch); emitted = [c.args[2] for c in mock_emit.calls]; assert emitted.count(AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_PATCH_REGISTERED) == 1; assert emitted.count(AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_REBUILD_REQUESTED) == 1; mock_emit_failing = mock(emit_audit_event, raises=RuntimeError()); await run_fix_pipeline_integration_phase(config, hub_client, slug=slug, branch_name=branch); assert no_exception_raised

property_tests.description: For any call to build_streams() where carry_patch.enabled is False or HubClient is None, the returned stream list contains no CarryPatchStream instance.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate combinations of: (enabled=False, hub_client=valid), (enabled=True, hub_client=None), (enabled=False, hub_client=None). Also vary other config fields randomly.
property_tests.invariant_check: for (enabled, hub_client) in [(False, mock_hub_client), (True, None), (False, None)]: config.carry_patch.enabled = enabled; streams = build_streams(config=config, hub_client=hub_client); assert not any(s.name == 'carry-patch' for s in streams)

property_tests.description: For any run_cycle() invocation that calls hub_client.list_rerere(), no write or mutation call is made to the rerere API.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate PatchStatusDashboard instances with 1 to 5 conflict patches. Mock hub_client with all methods tracked. Run run_cycle() with auto_resolve=True.
property_tests.invariant_check: write_rerere_methods = ['write_rerere', 'update_rerere', 'delete_rerere', 'set_rerere', 'patch_rerere']; await monitor.run_cycle(); for method_name in write_rerere_methods: mock_method = getattr(hub_client, method_name, None); if mock_method: assert mock_method.not_called()

property_tests.description: For any submit_rebuild() call that raises HubConflictError, hub_client.list_rebuilds() is always called and the first active RebuildJob is polled via poll_rebuild() without terminating early.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate scenarios where submit_rebuild() raises HubConflictError in both the fix pipeline and the monitor cycle. Vary list_rebuilds() responses: one job, multiple jobs, empty list.
property_tests.invariant_check: mock_submit = mock(hub_client.submit_rebuild, raises=HubConflictError()); mock_list = mock(hub_client.list_rebuilds, returns=[RebuildJob(id='j1', status='running')]); mock_poll = mock(poll_rebuild); await run_fix_pipeline_integration_phase(config, hub_client, slug='ws-1', branch_name='fix/b1'); assert mock_list.called_with('ws-1'); assert mock_poll.called(); mock_list_empty = mock(hub_client.list_rebuilds, returns=[]); await run_fix_pipeline_integration_phase(config, hub_client, slug='ws-1', branch_name='fix/b2'); assert mock_list_empty.called(); assert logger.has_warning()

edge_case_tests.description: When push_to_remote() raises an exception, the fix pipeline propagates it without calling add_patch() or submit_rebuild(), and marks the issue for retry.

edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: mock_push = mock(push_to_remote, raises=IOError('push failed')); mock_add = mock(hub_client.add_patch); mock_submit = mock(hub_client.submit_rebuild); mock_retry = mock(mark_issue_for_retry); with assert_raises(IOError): await run_fix_pipeline_integration_phase(config, hub_client, slug='ws-1', branch_name='fix/issue-42'); assert mock_add.not_called(); assert mock_submit.not_called(); assert mock_retry.called()

edge_case_tests.description: When poll_rebuild() exceeds its timeout, the fix pipeline logs the timeout, emits CARRY_PATCH_REBUILD_FAILED, and marks the issue for retry without raising.
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: mock_poll = mock(poll_rebuild, raises=asyncio.TimeoutError()); mock_emit = mock(emit_audit_event); mock_retry = mock(mark_issue_for_retry); await run_fix_pipeline_integration_phase(config, hub_client, slug='ws-1', branch_name='fix/issue-42'); assert logger.has_warning_or_error_containing('timeout'); emitted = [c.args[2] for c in mock_emit.calls]; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_REBUILD_FAILED in emitted; assert mock_retry.called()

edge_case_tests.description: When submit_rebuild() raises HubConflictError and list_rebuilds() returns an empty list, the fix pipeline logs a warning and skips rebuild polling without marking the issue for retry.
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: mock_submit = mock(hub_client.submit_rebuild, raises=HubConflictError()); mock_list = mock(hub_client.list_rebuilds, returns=[]); mock_poll = mock(poll_rebuild); mock_retry = mock(mark_issue_for_retry); await run_fix_pipeline_integration_phase(config, hub_client, slug='ws-1', branch_name='fix/issue-42'); assert mock_poll.not_called(); assert mock_retry.not_called(); assert logger.has_warning_containing('no active rebuild')

edge_case_tests.description: When hub_client.add_patch() raises an unexpected exception, the fix pipeline logs the error, emits CARRY_PATCH_REBUILD_FAILED, marks the issue for retry, and does not call submit_rebuild().
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: mock_add = mock(hub_client.add_patch, raises=RuntimeError('hub API error')); mock_submit = mock(hub_client.submit_rebuild); mock_emit = mock(emit_audit_event); mock_retry = mock(mark_issue_for_retry); await run_fix_pipeline_integration_phase(config, hub_client, slug='ws-1', branch_name='fix/issue-42'); assert mock_submit.not_called(); emitted = [c.args[2] for c in mock_emit.calls]; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_REBUILD_FAILED in emitted; assert mock_retry.called(); assert logger.has_error_containing('hub API error')

edge_case_tests.description: When poll_rebuild() resolves to a RebuildJob with status 'cancelled', the fix pipeline treats it as a failure: logs a warning, emits CARRY_PATCH_REBUILD_FAILED, and marks the issue for retry.

edge_case_tests.description: When carry_patch.enabled is False or no HubClient is provided, the fix pipeline executes the existing local harvest path and does not call any hub API methods.

edge_case_tests.description: When hub_client.get_patch_status() raises any exception, run_cycle() logs the error and returns an empty MonitorCycleResult with all counts at zero without propagating the exception.

edge_case_tests.description: When get_patch_status() returns a PatchStatusDashboard with an empty patch list, run_cycle() returns an empty MonitorCycleResult with all counts at zero.

edge_case_tests.description: When fetch_remote() or checkout_branch() raises an exception, run_cycle() logs the error, increments the retry counter and conflicts_failed, emits CARRY_PATCH_CONFLICT_FAILED, and continues to the next patch.
preconditions: PatchStatusDashboard has two conflict patches: 'p1' and 'p2'
fetch_remote() raises IOError for patch 'p1' only
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: mock_fetch = mock(fetch_remote, side_effect=lambda branch: raise IOError() if branch == 'p1-branch' else None); mock_emit = mock(emit_audit_event); result = await monitor.run_cycle(); assert monitor._retry_counter[('ws-1', 'p1')] == 1; assert result.conflicts_failed == 1; assert result.conflicts_resolved == 1; emitted = [c.args[2] for c in mock_emit.calls]; assert AuditEventType.CARRY_PATCH_CONFLICT_FAILED in emitted

edge_case_tests.description: When engine._run_coder_session() exceeds the session timeout, run_cycle() cancels the coroutine, logs a warning, increments the retry counter and conflicts_failed, and continues to the next patch.
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: mock_coder = mock(engine._run_coder_session, raises=asyncio.TimeoutError()); mock_push = mock(push_to_remote); mock_submit = mock(hub_client.submit_rebuild); result = await monitor.run_cycle(); assert monitor._retry_counter[('ws-1', 'p1')] == 1; assert result.conflicts_failed == 1; assert mock_push.not_called(); assert mock_submit.not_called(); assert logger.has_warning_containing('timeout')

edge_case_tests.description: When submit_rebuild() raises HubConflictError after a successful resolution in the monitor, run_cycle() calls list_rebuilds() and polls the active job, setting rebuild_triggered=True.

edge_case_tests.description: When a PatchDetail is missing conflict_files, run_cycle() defaults conflict_files to an empty list, logs a warning, and continues processing the patch.
